content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-97 (bundled/not separately payable), and prior appeals with necessity and records both failed with repeated CO-97. Medical necessity is not the issue here—bundling is a coding/edit dispute, so another necessity appeal won't help. A peer-to-peer is clinical and won't resolve a bundling edit either. The correct next step is to fix the claim's coding to properly unbundle (e.g., appropriate modifier) and resubmit so the payer edit re-adjudicates.","action":"correct_and_resubmit"}
